title: Boston Gas Company files for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy a Firm Transportation Agreement with First Republic Corporation of America.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department APPROVES the Company's proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms under the Agreement are competitively sensitive and therefore, GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating in the decision were: Paul G. Afonso, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating, Eugene J. Sullivan, Jr., and Deirdre K. Manning. GC03-20.
